title: Correct final altitude
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final numerical answer for the minimum altitude must be 198 m.

title: Pre-jettison acceleration
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the downward acceleration before jettison as 2 m/s² using the given change in velocity and time.

title: Force balance before jettison
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply Newton's second law to the balloon before jettison to solve for the buoyant force.

title: Force balance after jettison
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply Newton's second law to the balloon after jettison to find the new upward acceleration.

title: Kinematics for safe landing
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly use kinematics (v² = u² + 2as) with the final safe speed, initial speed, and new acceleration to find the required distance.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses an incorrect sign for the acceleration (e.g., treating deceleration as positive without adjusting kinematics).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student's working shows consistent use of SI units (m, s, m/s², kg, N) throughout.
